column3: BrowserBackend has three calls: start, run and close (delete); there is no stop
column4: Bosun decided on #124 that an idle machine is deleted, not stopped: a restart is not faster than a create (about 6 s vs 2 s plus a 3 s install), and a stopped machine keeps billing its 20 GiB disk. With no stop, nothing restarts a machine, so stop and the start-a-stopped-machine branch were dead and are removed. A Cloudflare Browser Rendering session maps close to ending the session
